title: Home page-only dark luxury visual + motion refinements (no layout/content changes)

requirements.summary: Confine all visual/motion refinements strictly to the existing Home page and home-route-specific styles without changing structure, routing, or content, and without impacting any non-Home pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page keeps the same sections and order (Hero, Crafting Quality Section, Feature Cards Section, CTA Section, Footer).
No text/content strings are changed on the Home page.
Non-Home pages (Products, About, Catalogue, Contact, etc.) render identically to before this change (no new backgrounds/animations/colors applied).

file_operations.description: Adjust only existing class usage/parameters (no DOM restructuring and no text edits) to support Home-only refinements (e.g., parallax subtlety, container width constraints) while keeping the current section order and hierarchy unchanged.
Limit all new/changed styling to existing Home-only selectors (home-* classes and Home-only tokens) so no non-Home pages are visually affected; avoid changing shared/global non-home selectors.

requirements.summary: Remove all light/white backgrounds on the Home page and implement a cohesive layered deep-navy background system with smooth blending (Top #0b1622 → Middle #0f1f2f → Lower #0b1622) and no hard section breaks.
acceptanceCriteria: No Home page section uses a white/light background (including transitions/dividers).
Home page backgrounds visually blend from #0b1622 → #0f1f2f → #0b1622 without abrupt color jumps.
The Home page wrapper/sections use only the navy–gold–charcoal palette (no new accent colors introduced).

file_operations.description: Update .home-page-wrapper and Home section backgrounds to a single cohesive layered deep-navy system (Top #0b1622, Middle #0f1f2f, Lower #0b1622), ensuring sections either inherit/are transparent or use matching gradients so transitions blend smoothly with no hard color breaks; ensure no Home element uses light/white panels.

requirements.summary: Increase Home Hero readability and depth while keeping the current hero image: add a cinematic dark overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.55), set headline contrast to #f5f2ea with soft shadow, and keep parallax very subtle (respect prefers-reduced-motion).
acceptanceCriteria: Hero image remains unchanged and still loads from /assets/generated/hero-equestrian-editorial.dim_1600x900.png.
An overlay equivalent to rgba(0,0,0,0.55) is present over the hero image to improve text readability.
Hero headline text color is #f5f2ea (or visually equivalent) and has a soft shadow for contrast.
Parallax effect is subtle and disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

file_operations.description: Reduce the parallax intensity for the hero image (keep using the existing useParallax hook) to make the effect very subtle; do not change the hero image source, section structure, or any text.

Adjust Home hero overlay styling so a cinematic dark overlay equivalent to rgba(0,0,0,0.55) sits over the hero image (while retaining the existing vignette/gradient layering), and set .home-hero-headline color to #f5f2ea with a soft text shadow for contrast.

requirements.summary: Tune Home hero entrance animations to luxury timing and subtle motion: headline fade + small rise over 900ms ease-out; subtext delay 150ms; buttons delay 300ms; disable under prefers-reduced-motion.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial Home page load, headline animates with fade + small upward rise using 900ms ease-out.
Subtext animation starts 150ms after the headline begins; buttons start 300ms after the headline begins.
When prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, hero entrance animations do not animate (content is immediately visible without transforms).

file_operations.description: Update Home hero entrance animation definitions (.home-hero-entrance-text, .home-hero-entrance-text-delayed, .home-hero-entrance-buttons) to use 900ms ease-out timing, set delays to 150ms and 300ms respectively, and reduce rise distance to a subtle value; keep prefers-reduced-motion overrides so animations are disabled and content is immediately visible.

requirements.summary: Refine the Home Crafting Quality section: keep it dark and gradient-continuous, constrain text container to 680px, increase vertical padding, add a thin centered animated gold divider line, and apply subtle scroll reveal (fade + ~30px rise) with reduced-motion support; optional subtle radial glow behind heading.
acceptanceCriteria: Crafting section background is dark and blends with the overall Home gradient (no light/white panels).
Crafting section text container max width is 680px.
A thin centered gold divider line animates its width expansion (and is static if prefers-reduced-motion is enabled).
Crafting section reveals on scroll with subtle fade + rise (no flashy effects).

file_operations.description: Constrain the Crafting Quality section content container to max width 680px (update existing max-w utility values only) and adjust section padding utilities if needed, without changing any content strings or section structure.

Ensure .home-section-crafting uses a dark background that blends with the overall Home layered navy system; refine the gold divider line styling to be thinner/centered with animated expansion (and static under prefers-reduced-motion); keep/confirm the existing Home scroll reveal behavior remains subtle (fade + ~30px rise) and optionally retain a very subtle radial glow behind the heading.

requirements.summary: Upgrade Home Feature Cards to premium glass styling with exact base/hover values, and ensure subtle staggered entrances (0.15s increments) with reduced-motion support.
acceptanceCriteria: Each feature card uses rgba(20,30,45,0.65) background with 12px backdrop blur and a gold-tinted border at rgba(212,175,55,0.15).
Hover state lifts cards by ~6px, increases border gold intensity, and adds a subtle glow shadow (no harsh/big glow).
Card entrances are staggered by 0.15s between cards and are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

file_operations.description: Update .home-glass-card base styling to background rgba(20,30,45,0.65), backdrop blur 12px, and border 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15); update hover styling to translateY(-6px) with a brighter gold border and a subtle glow shadow; ensure reveal transitions remain subtle and are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

Keep the existing 0ms/150ms/300ms staggered transition delays between feature cards (0.15s increments), adjusting only if necessary to exactly match 0.15s steps, without altering card content or layout.

requirements.summary: Enhance the divider between Feature Cards and CTA and refine CTA styling: add a subtle thin centered gold glow line between sections, keep CTA background dark, add a soft radial warm glow behind the CTA heading, and set CTA button gold to #c9a14a with hover glow + scale 1.03 and a smooth 250ms transition (reduced-motion safe).
acceptanceCriteria: A thin, centered, low-opacity horizontal gold glow divider is visible between the feature cards section and the CTA section (no bright or thick line).
CTA heading has a subtle radial warm glow behind it (kept understated).
CTA button base color is #c9a14a and hover uses a 250ms smooth transition with slight glow and scale to ~1.03 (scale suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion if necessary).

file_operations.description: Implement a very thin, centered, low-opacity horizontal gold glow divider between the highlights and CTA using Home-only styles (e.g., styling the existing .home-section-transition to render the subtle line and preserve smooth navy blending); ensure CTA section stays dark and blends with the Home layered navy system; refine .home-cta-spotlight to remain understated.

Update .home-btn-cta to use base gold color #c9a14a, and set hover to include a subtle glow and scale to ~1.03 with a 250ms smooth transition; ensure reduced-motion rules suppress scaling if necessary.

requirements.summary: Make the Home footer fully dark luxury (Home route only) with specified colors and borders while keeping non-Home footers unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home route only, the footer background is #08121a with a top border rgba(212,175,55,0.15).
Home footer body text is #b8b8b8 and headings are gold-toned.
On non-Home routes, footer styling remains unchanged compared to before this change.

file_operations.description: Update Home-only footer styling: set .home-footer background to #08121a (and/or update --home-footer-dark token to match), keep top border 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15), ensure .home-footer-text is #b8b8b8 and headings remain soft gold; do not change non-home footer classes (.footer-navy, .footer-link, etc.).

Keep the existing Home-route conditional styling behavior (isHome) intact and ensure it continues to apply only Home-specific footer classes; do not change footer content text or non-home class assignments.
